'''Kerestians''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. The [[big game hunter]] [[Iothene Jacontro]] was a member of this species.<ref name="The Official Guide" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Kerestians first appeared in the [[1993]] [[West End Games]] Star Wars sourcebook, [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], and were officially canonized in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.
